name: Samuel Dennis Warren
bioAdditions: Hammond (S1): Samuel Warren (V, b. Watertown 18 Mar 1704, m. 1728 Tabitha Stone) -> Joseph (b. Grafton 22 Apr 1745, d. 1808, m. Lois Lyons) -> John (b. Grafton 28 Nov 1767, d. 17 Jun 1828, m. 2nd 1804 Susanna Groat) -> 'Samuel Dennis Warren, the founder of the well known firm of S. D. Warren & Co., of Boston'. With Samuel Warren (V) descending from William Hammond through Lt. John Hammond and the Hastings line, S. D. Warren is a 6th cousin 6 times removed. His sister Anna Groat Warren's son George Warren Hammond helped compile the Hammond genealogy.

sources.citation: Frederick S. Hammond, History and Genealogies of the Hammond Families in America, vol. 1 (1902) (archive.org full text), pp. 90-91
